name: crm-test-host
description: Entry point for cPanel AI App Hosting (crm-test.drana.ro). Builds the API from the monorepo root into dist/main.js.

scripts.build: cd ../.. && npm ci && NX_NO_CLOUD=true npx nx run @org/api:build:production --thirdParty=true && mkdir -p deploy/crm-test/dist && cp apps/api/dist/main.js deploy/crm-test/dist/main.js
